Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog:
- Bone Align: Match facing now flips you 180 degrees automatically when an animation was made for the opposite facing (e.g. 306 Kittylingus), by checking which way leaves your bodies not overlapping. No more turning around first.
- Fix: conflicts between two options of the same mod (e.g. two GoonersLife groups both on GroundSit) now get a "Conflict: keep this" button that deselects the other option.
